conversations.invalid: Invalid conversation, message or text attachment.
conversations.changed: This conversation changed. Reload before saving.
conversations.agentDisabled: This Agent is disabled or archived.
conversations.directoryMissing: The Agent directory is missing or inaccessible.
conversations.cliMissing: The CLI is missing or its inspection failed.
conversations.loginRequired: Log in to the native CLI as the Runner account before starting.
conversations.bindingChanged: The execution account, CLI or directory changed. Create a new conversation.
conversations.busy: Wait for the active turn to finish or stop it first.
conversations.archived: This conversation is archived or interrupted. Reopen it or create a new conversation as appropriate.
conversations.staleDecision: This permission request is no longer active or already has a decision.
conversations.leaseLost: This turn already ended elsewhere or timed out, so later results were not recorded. Refresh to see the latest state.
conversations.interrupted: Execution was interrupted. Retry the last message or keep typing to continue with a fresh native session and completed chat history. Check previous operation results before retrying; nothing is replayed automatically.
conversations.preflightFailed: The execution environment could not be verified. Check the Agent and Runner connection.
conversations.executionFailed: The CLI run failed or the connection dropped. Check what it already did before retrying.
conversations.outputLimit: Execution exceeded the output limit and was stopped.
conversations.fileTooLarge: Each file must be at most 32 MiB.
conversations.apiPending: API Agents do not need a host CLI probe. Check the connection on the model page.
conversations.noRunner: No available Runner can execute this model.
conversations.cliPermissionUnsupported: This CLI supports read-only conversations only. Choose read-only access.
conversations.runnerUpgradeRequired: Upgrade the host Runner to enable platform tools before starting this conversation.
conversations.hostSwitched: Switched execution from host {from} to {to}. The CLI session was rebuilt from this conversation's history in Ferry; files in {from}'s working directory were not carried over.
conversations.hostReleased: Released host {host}. The next message is assigned to another host; the CLI session will be rebuilt from this conversation's history in Ferry, and files in {host}'s working directory are not carried over.
conversations.hostUnavailable: Execution host {host} cannot run this now: {reason}. This conversation has a fixed working directory, so it does not move to another host by itself; choose "Use another host" to switch.
conversations.executionFailedOn: {cli} failed on host {host} or the connection dropped. Check what it already did before retrying; the host's Runner log has the details.
conversations.boundHostOffline: The bound host {host} is offline right now ({reason}). Other candidate hosts: {others}
conversations.boundHostOfflineNoOthers: The bound host {host} is offline right now ({reason}) and there is no other candidate host. Try again once it is back online.
conversations.messageEmpty: Type a message or attach a file before sending.
conversations.messageText: The message contains null characters (\0); remove them and send again.
conversations.clientInvalid: This page sent an invalid request; reload the page and send again.
conversations.tooManyAttachments: A message can carry at most 10 attachments.
conversations.attachmentNameInvalid: The attachment name "{name}" is invalid: it must be 1–255 bytes without control characters; rename the file and attach it again.
conversations.messageTooLong: The message and its text attachments together exceed 48 KB; shorten it or send the content as a file.
conversations.messageTooLongWithInstruct: Together with the agent's instructions, this message exceeds 63 KB; shorten the message or the agent's instructions.
conversations.tooManyTargets: A message can address at most 8 agents at once.
conversations.kindInvalid: Choose a conversation type: private or group.
conversations.tooManyMembers: A group can have at most 100 members.
conversations.tooManyAgents: A group can have at most 8 agents.
conversations.agentRequired: Choose an agent for the conversation.
conversations.titleInvalid: The conversation title must be at most 256 bytes and cannot contain null characters.
conversations.stateInvalid: The conversation status must be active, archived or interrupted.
conversations.questionInvalid: Invalid question or response. Provide a clear question, unique suggestions, or a response of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
conversations.questionPending: A saved question is waiting for the user, or this turn is still finishing. Do not continue operations; wait for the user or retry the response after the turn ends.
conversations.questionAnswered: This question already has a different response. Refresh to see it; do not submit a conflicting answer.
conversations.approvalModeInvalid: Choose request, assisted or yolo approval mode.
conversations.apiContextChanged: The model profile, provider or model for this conversation has changed. Restore its original configuration or start a new conversation; the saved context has been retained.
conversations.apiOutputRequired: This Anthropic model requires an output token limit in its model configuration. Configure that limit before sending another message.
conversations.introductionTask: Generate your first introduction in English now. This automatic task is not a human message. Use only the configured facts and effective permissions; briefly greet, explain your role and grounded help, and ask what the user wants. Do not claim completed checks or actions or invent capabilities.
conversations.introductionPermission: The introduction did not run because you lack conversation run or read permission. Ask an administrator to grant access, then retry the introduction explicitly.
conversations.introductionDisabled: Automatic introductions are disabled. Enable them in platform settings before retrying.
conversations.introductionStale: This introduction belongs to an earlier Agent membership and cannot be retried.
conversations.introductionCompleted: This Agent has already completed its introduction for this membership.
conversations.introductionRetryWarning: A previous attempt may have reached the model or performed operations with an unknown outcome. Verify its result before explicitly starting another introduction; another model call may incur usage.
